title: Something hit Uranus so hard, it's still on its side 🪐
caption:
Uranus took a hit and never got back up 🪐💥
Share with someone who needs this pun 👇
sources: NASA Solar System Exploration, 'Uranus' (axial tilt about 98°; 42 years of continuous sunlight/darkness at each pole; coldest planetary atmosphere, about -224 °C minimum)

Kegerreis J. A. et al. (2018) 'Consequences of giant impacts on early Uranus for rotation, internal structure, debris, and atmospheric escape', The Astrophysical Journal 861: 52 (impactor about twice Earth's mass)
